qs.s: Les enfants adorent cette ___ de la pop.
qs.en: The children love this pop star.

qs.en: He dreams of becoming a great sports star.

qs.en: This director always prefers to work with a true big-name film star.

qs.en: He admires the star who acted in this film.

qs.en: The cook adds a grain of salt to the soup to enhance its flavor.

qs.en: She wears a necklace with each bead carefully polished.

qs.en: The rosary is made of fifty beads; I count each bead between my fingers.

qs.en: The barista selects each coffee bean before roasting it.

qs.en: To make chocolate, cacao beans are pressed; a single cacao bean can be enough to test the quality.

qs.en: The film photo has a visible grain that gives it a particular texture.

qs.en: She has a beauty mark on her right cheek that makes her very distinctive.

qs.en: The dermatologist examined each mole on her back to check that they were normal.

qs.en: Organising a trip for ten people is really complicated.

qs.en: These administrative problems are complicated to solve.

qs.en: The calculations presented in this report are too complicated.

qs.en: This recipe is a bit complicated, but the result is worth it.

qs.s: La procédure d'inscription est vraiment ___ cette année.
qs.en: The registration procedure is really complicated this year.

qs.s: Les relations entre ces deux pays sont devenues ___ après la crise.
qs.en: Relations between the two countries became complicated after the crisis.

qs.s: Ces équations sont trop ___ pour moi.
qs.en: These equations are too complicated for me.
